title: Adventurous Snappy Ethiopian Manchego Ye Beg Alichia
description: A fatty and snappy Ethiopian dish featuring Manchego cheese, this recipe combines the flavors of Ethiopia with a low-glycemic twist, served in a traditional dolsot stone bowl. It is a unique and adventurous take on traditional Ye Beg Alichia.
instructions: Heat the ghee in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until it is lightly browned.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the berbere spice and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the khao khuas and cook for 2 minutes, stirring frequently.
Stir in the shredded Manchego cheese until it is fully melted and incorporated.
Add the chopped cilantro and dried fenugreek leaves, stirring to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a dolsot stone bowl and serve immediately.
Garnish with additional cilantro and fenugreek leaves, if desired.
